method: Equal-weight mean of per-mouse right-continuous ECDFs; identical mouse sets on D0 and D14; all retained crossings including two-crossing D0 mouse. All slips including stop overlaps and outside tape; no new clipping/smoothing/binning. No inferential tests; cages not equally weighted.
score: Sum max(MovementTrace-2.5,0) over inclusive slip frames
validation: All 84 reconstructed mouse-day totals match saved combinedSlipMagnitude at rtol=1e-6 atol=1e-6; all scores finite and positive
